subject: Film & Cinema
title: Lighting a Face: Three-Point Setup
description: Learn Lighting a Face: Three-Point Setup in one minute.

hook.text: Every face you see on screen is sculpted by light. The setup is called three-point lighting.

buildup.text: A key light illuminates, a fill light softens shadows, and a back light separates from background.

discovery.text: Classic Hollywood glamour came from placing lights to flatter — everyone looked like a star.

twist.text: Modern films often break the three-point rule deliberately to create unease or realism.

climax.text: Understanding how light hits a face is the foundation of all cinematic portraiture.

punchline.text: Three lights build every face you've ever loved on screen.

quiz.question: What are the three lights in three-point lighting?
options: Key light, fill light, and back light
